title: LED language driver: 6-state blink table (all tiers)
description: Implement the fixed LED state table from spec 19 §10. Six states only, no others: joined-idle=off, joining=0.5Hz/10%, message-waiting=0.25Hz/5%, SOS-active=2Hz/50%/continuous, hold-in-progress=4Hz/50%, fault=1Hz/50%. New patterns require amending the spec table, not inventing at the driver level. Applies to tier H primarily but also E/O LEDs. Spans spec 19 requirements 57-64.
